model_organism.citation: Systematic Disruption of Zebrafish Fibrillin Genes Identifies a Translational Zebrafish Model for Marfan Syndrome (PMID: 42025244)
phenotypes: Zebrafish mutants lacking various fibrillin genes (including fbn1) were generated
Only fibrillin-3-deficient zebrafish showed cardiovascular phenotypes mimicking human disease
fbn3 mutants had early cardiac defects, bulbus arteriosus dilation and valve abnormalities
fbn3 mutants showed altered ECM homeostasis and immune activation pathways in transcriptomics
The fbn1 mutant did not show a comparable cardiovascular phenotype

model_organism.citation: Phenotyping Zebrafish Mutant Models to Assess Candidate Genes Associated with Aortic Aneurysm (PMID: 35052463)
phenotypes: CRISPR/Cas9 fbn1 loss-of-function 'positive control' mutant
Peri-aortic and cranial hemorrhage
Cardiomegaly
Reduced diameter of the aorta and intersegmental vessels
Lower aortic cell counts
Severe scoliosis
Cardiac, cerebral, aortic and skeletal abnormalities by 6 dpf

model_organism.citation: Novel Aortic Dissection Model Links Endothelial Dysfunction and Immune Infiltration (PMID: 40365676)
phenotypes: Fbn1 G234D/G234D CRISPR knock-in missense mice (loss-of-function: FBN1 G234D lost binding to LTBP-1, -2 and -4)
Premature death within 5 weeks from aortic rupture
Multiple intimomedial tears that expanded longitudinally
Massive immune cell infiltration
Endothelial cells lost alignment to blood flow, with upregulated VCAM-1 and ICAM-1 by 1 week
Monocyte/macrophage clusters (CCR2+) in the intima
Upregulated MMP2/9
Downregulated TGFβ signaling in the aortic wall

model_organism.citation: Extracellular Tuning of Mitochondrial Respiration Leads to Aortic Aneurysm (PMID: 33709773)
phenotypes: Fbn1 C1039G/+ MFS mice showed mitochondrial dysfunction and mtDNA depletion in the aorta
Reduced mitochondrial complexes in young mutant aortas
Fbn1-silenced VSMCs had increased lactate production and decreased oxygen consumption
Matrices from Fbn1-deficient VSMCs caused mitochondrial dysfunction in seeded VSMCs
Nicotinamide riboside reversed aortic aneurysm in mutant mice
Conditional VSMC Tfam knockout mice lost contractile capacity, developed aortic aneurysm and died prematurely

phenotypes: Fbn1 C1041G/+ aortic dilation
Versican accumulation in the aorta, with Nos2 induction and Akt activation
Vcan haploinsufficiency protected against aortic dilation
Vcan silencing reverted aortic disease
Akt inhibition regressed aortic dilation

Increased inflammation and ECM remodelling
Increased TGF-β pathway activation via reduced TGFBR2 endocytosis and autophagy
Yoda1 activation of PIEZO1 reversed TAA

model_organism.citation: The mgΔ(lpn) mouse model for Marfan syndrome recapitulates the ocular phenotypes of the disease (PMID: 33516761)

Ectopia lentis
Increased distance between ciliary body and lens at 3 and 6 months
Disorganized microfibril mesh on the ciliary body
Larger anterior chamber volume
Limited efficacy of losartan on ocular phenotypes

model_organism.citation: ASHG 2023 - Atropine treatment rescues myopia in a mouse model of Marfan syndrome
phenotypes: Fbn1 C1039G/+ mice had increased axial length (60 µm) and high myopia (9 D) at 2 months
Increased Smad2/3 and Erk1/2 activation in the retina
Losartan did not prevent eye growth
Low-dose or less frequent atropine selectively inhibited eye growth in MFS mice
Atropine normalized retinal Smad2/3 activation
model_organism.significance: p<0.0001 (axial length and myopia vs WT)

model_organism.citation: ASHG 2017 - Functional characterization of modifier loci for Marfan syndrome reveals novel therapeutic strategies
phenotypes: Fbn1 C1039G/+ strain-dependent aneurysm severity and survival (129S6 worse than C57BL/6J)
QTLs on chromosomes 5 and 11 linked to aortic size
Mmp17 and Map2k6 variants modified aortic growth
Double null alleles at both loci made the mice behave like BL6
Aneurysm prevented by AngII receptor blocker, ERK inhibitor or erlotinib
model_organism.significance: p=0.008 for QTLs; p=0.0006 for epistasis

Induction of a degradative SMC phenotype

biological.citation: Wang et al. 2020 - FBN1 promotes DLBCL cell migration by activating the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway and regulating TIMP1 (PMID: 33312371)
biological.summary: FBN1 is highly expressed in DLBCL tissues, and higher expression is associated with advanced stage, higher IPI score and non-GCB subtype. FBN1 siRNA decreased TIMP1 expression, DLBCL cell migration and Wnt target gene expression. TIMP1 knockdown did not change FBN1, so FBN1 acts upstream of TIMP1 in Wnt/β-catenin signaling.

biological.citation: Shen et al. 2022 - The Fibrillin-1/VEGFR2/STAT2 signaling axis promotes chemoresistance via modulating glycolysis and angiogenesis in ovarian cancer organoids and cells (PMID: 35234370)
biological.summary: FBN1 expression is elevated in cisplatin-resistant ovarian cancer organoids and tissues. FBN1 knockout reduced glycolysis and angiogenesis and increased cisplatin sensitivity in organoids, cell lines, nude mice and zebrafish. FBN1 mediates VEGFR2 Tyr1054 phosphorylation, which activates FAK/AKT and STAT2 Tyr690 phosphorylation and nuclear translocation.

biological.citation: Doyle et al. ASHG 2023 - Atropine treatment rescues myopia in a mouse model of Marfan syndrome
biological.summary: Fbn1 C1039G/+ mice show increased axial length and high myopia, with increased retinal Smad2/3 and Erk1/2 activation. Losartan had no effect on eye growth. Low-dose atropine selectively inhibited eye growth and normalized Smad2/3 activation in the MFS retina.
biological.significance: p<0.0001 (axial length, myopia, Smad2/3 normalization); p<0.01 (selective low-dose atropine effect)

biological.citation: Shimizu et al. ASHG 2023 - A novel FBN1 intron variant causing isolated ectopia lentis via an in-frame exon skipping
biological.summary: The FBN1 intron 11 variant c.1327+3A>C causes in-frame skipping of exon 11 in patient PBMC RT-PCR and in minigene assays. Exon 11 encodes the 60-amino-acid proline-rich region, and its loss is linked to isolated ectopia lentis without systemic Marfan features.

biological.citation: Cano-Jorge/Oller et al. 2021 - Extracellular Tuning of Mitochondrial Respiration Leads to Aortic Aneurysm (PMID: 33709773)
biological.summary: Aortas from Fbn1c1039g/+ mice and MFS patients show mitochondrial dysfunction and mtDNA depletion. Fbn1-silenced VSMCs have increased lactate production and decreased oxygen consumption. VSMCs grown on matrix made by Fbn1-deficient VSMCs also develop mitochondrial dysfunction, and nicotinamide riboside reverses aneurysm in Fbn1c1039g/+ mice.

A novel FBN1 mutation deleting three domains abolishes the fibrillin-1 binding site for ADAMTSL2, ADAMTSL3, ADAMTSL6 and papilin. In mice this causes a Weill-Marchesani-like phenotype (thick skin, short stature, brachydactyly) distinct from MFS. The results place the ADAMTSL proteins in a pathway with fibrillin-1 and ADAMTS10 that maintains tissue microenvironments.

biological.citation: Fibrillin-1 Orchestrates a Pro-senescent Niche Driving Peritubular Endothelial Senescence via ZEB1/endothelin-1/β-catenin Signaling (PMID: 42328432)
biological.summary: FBN1 in the fibrogenic niche of CKD kidneys upregulates ZEB1, which binds the EDN1 promoter to increase ET-1 and activate β-catenin signaling, driving endothelial senescence. Tubule-specific Fbn1 deletion reduced endothelial senescence and capillary rarefaction and improved renal function across CKD models.

biological.citation: Single-Cell Transcriptomic Profiling of Vascular Smooth Muscle Cell Phenotype Modulation in Marfan Syndrome Aortic Aneurysm (PMID: 32698686)
biological.summary: scRNA-seq of Fbn1C1041G/+ mouse aortic root tissue and human MFS aneurysm identified a modulated SMC cluster with an MFS-specific signature (Serpine1, Klf4) and 481 differentially expressed genes. Enhanced TGF-β-responsive gene expression correlated with SMC modulation, implicating TGF-β signaling and Klf4 as drivers.

biological.citation: PIEZO1 attenuates Marfan syndrome aneurysm development through TGF-β signaling pathway inhibition via TGFBR2 (PMID: 39585648)
biological.summary: PIEZO1 expression is decreased in aortas of Fbn1C1041G/+ MFS mice and patients. VSMC-specific Piezo1 knockout in MFS mice worsened thoracic aortic aneurysm and TGF-β pathway activation through impaired Rab GTPase 3C-mediated TGFBR2 endocytosis and autophagy. The PIEZO1 activator Yoda1 reversed aneurysm in MFS mice.

biological.citation: FGF12 induces aberrant mechanosignaling in aortic smooth muscle cells during thoracic aortic aneurysm formation in Marfan syndrome mice (PMID: 41540272)
biological.summary: FGF12 is upregulated in aortic SMCs of Fbn1C1039G/+ mice and MFS patients, induced by TGF-β/SMAD signaling and cyclic stretch. It activates AngII/AT1R and RhoA mechanosignaling. Fgf12 haploinsufficiency reduced aneurysm progression and arterial stiffening in Fbn1C1039G/+ mice.

biological.citation: Asprosin and type 2 diabetes mellitus: a novel potential therapeutic implication (PMID: 32080995)
biological.summary: Asprosin is a fasting-induced hormone encoded by FBN1 (the C-terminal fibrillin-1 cleavage product) and secreted by white adipose tissue. It acts on the liver through the cAMP-PKA pathway to raise glucose. Levels are higher in T2DM, and deficiency causes leanness and poor appetite.
